# Mr. Streamer

> A free, open-source desktop IPTV player for macOS, Windows and Linux. Bring your own Xtream Codes subscription or M3U playlist. No channels or subscriptions are included.

## Downloads and guides

- [Downloads](https://mrstreamer.app/download): Current stable installers, system requirements, checksums and source archives.
- [Guides](https://mrstreamer.app/docs): Using subscriptions, live TV, movies and series, downloads, updates and playback.
- [Subscriptions](https://mrstreamer.app/docs/subscriptions): Connect Xtream Codes or an M3U playlist and manage your sources.
- [FAQ](https://mrstreamer.app/faq): Answers about setup, supported systems and playback.
- [Release notes](https://mrstreamer.app/releases): Published stable releases and their changes.

## Project and policies

- [About](https://mrstreamer.app/about): Product capabilities and supported desktop systems.
- [Source repository](https://github.com/Mr-Streamer-OSS/MrStreamer): Public source code and contribution guidance.
- [License](https://github.com/Mr-Streamer-OSS/MrStreamer/blob/main/LICENSE): GPL-3.0 license terms.
- [Privacy](https://mrstreamer.app/privacy): Data storage, connections, analytics and privacy choices.
- [Security](https://mrstreamer.app/security): Login storage, installer verification and reporting vulnerabilities.

## Community and support

- [Discord](https://discord.gg/sR4tjEw6bQ): Public community and help.
- [Report a bug](https://github.com/Mr-Streamer-OSS/MrStreamer/issues/new/choose): Bug-report templates and required details.
